posts.body_html: I'm rebuilding my Sarracenia collection because I recently moved to the USA and as you must know by now, once you start whith this hobby it is hard to live without carnivorous plants. To be honest buying from Mike is a pleasure, I think that most of the plants that I have are from him and I plan on keeping it that way. He is one of the few growers that I know that have a correct label system including location data which is really important for me. Also genetics are awesome, you never get dissapointed from the great quality plants he has. It doesn't matter if your're a newbie or an expert growing this amazing plants, for sure he will have the right plant for you!

posts.body_html:
Today my order from Mike came and I could not have been happier!  They look fantastic.  I ordered:

S. flava var. rugelii Bulloch Co, GA- LG 
S. flava var. rugelii Okaloosa Co, FL
S. flava var. rugelii clone#3 Santa Rosa Co, FL- large
S. leucophylla hurricane creek white clone A, large

I received three freebies- a cuprea (Bill Hoyer x Bontinque), a minor Okee giant Ware Co., GA, and ANOTHER Oakloosa Co., FL rugelii.

As I was potting them up, they hadn't been outside for even ten minutes, a wasp promptly fell inside one of the giant pitchers.

These plants were really big, the HCW had two growth points and two of the rugeliis had 2" rhizomes!

No pun intended, these are KILLER plants from Mike!

Attachments:

posts.body_html: I just received my first order from Mike Wang, and I couldn't be happier with it! Mike was very helpful in selecting a great plant and promptly shipped it out. After having ordered many times from some of the large nurseries and receiving such tiny starter plants, I was so pleasantly surprised to receive such a large beautiful plant from Mike, and he was so kind to give me a beautiful free bonus plant! Wish I had found Mike to order from sooner, but when I want more plants in the future I will certainly be reaching out to him for more. if you are looking for a Sarracenia, order from Mike! It will come healthy, well packaged and promptly!
